newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Palestinians reduce Wednesday death toll to five.
newsitem.headline: Palestinians reduce Wednesday death toll to five.

text.p: A Palestinian hospital director said on Thursday that five, not seven, Palestinians were shot dead in clashes with Israeli soldiers on Wednesday.

Ramallah hospital director Mohammad Aideh reduced the toll which a senior PLO official had placed at seven. A hospital in Gaza said another Palestinian was killed in a gunbattle near a Jewish settlement there on Thursday, raising the toll in two days of clashes to six Palestinians.
